### 🟢 Approval recommended The focused mapping change preserves existing behavior, includes corresponding regression coverage, and has no identified blocking issues. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Expands Gemini finish-reason handling so content-blocked responses are reported as `CONTENT_FILTER` rather than `None`. **Changes:** - Maps six additional finish reasons to `CONTENT_FILTER`. - Adds parameterized regression coverage for each added reason. - Preserves other mappings and leaves the deprecated Vertex AI connector unchanged. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​google/​google_ai/​services/​test_google_ai_utils.py | Tests all six added content-filter reasons. | | python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​google_ai/​services/​utils.py | Groups content-filter reasons and checks membership. |
Review effort: Balanced

comments.body: @eavanvalkenburg thanks for the approval. This was dropped from the merge queue by the merge-group run [40323553321](https://github.com/microsoft/semantic-kernel/actions/runs/40323553321), where "Python Pre-Merge Integration Tests - Agents" failed on an empty JSON response from Azure (`azure.core` `DecodeError`). The PR only touches `google_ai/services/utils.py` and its unit test, and its own checks are green, so it looks unrelated. Could you add it back to the queue when you have a moment?
